environment.description: EKS pod running in namespace 'pki-services' with default SecurityContext. Container runs as root (UID 0). Pod spec uses 'emptyDir' volume mounts. No filesystem restrictions beyond standard container isolation. The gRPC port 50051 is exposed via a ClusterIP Service with no NetworkPolicy restricting ingress. Container filesystem has standard Linux permissions with /etc/shadow readable by root. HSM integration via CloudHSM PKCS#11 library is configured but the path traversal in GetCertificate and GetKeyMetadata allows reading arbitrary files on the container filesystem.
